summary: Deploy new version with migration apply, ensure customer_note column exists (IF NOT EXISTS), backfill note values into customer_note, retire old version, and skip dropping note column to avoid conflict with cross‑version smoke tests.
write_consistency: During overlap old version writes to note, new version writes to customer_note; back‑fill before deploy ensures both columns hold same data initially, so reads from either column return consistent values.
revision_notes: Previous plan a2‑s01‑cn‑02 failed at contract stage because dropping note column removed it while the runner’s cross‑version smoke test still referenced note, causing ProgrammingError. Root cause: duplicate column addition in earlier attempt and premature column drop. This revised plan omits the DROP COLUMN contract stage and uses IF NOT EXISTS to safely create customer_note, avoiding the conflict.

stages.description: Add customer_note column if it does not already exist.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customer_note TEXT NULL;

stages.description: Retire the old version; old code no longer serves traffic.
